featured_reviews.name: Ananya Bar
featured_reviews.review_text:
New Alpha Academy is a very good school for growing kids. We as a family were always worried for our son's first entry in school. But when we visited the school first time and met their director, Principal and all the Teachers, we were very much satisfied after talking to them. Further, while going through the school visit we were amazed and surprised the way they take care of our children in their learning. The atmosphere of the school is very good. Our son Johan Masih likes it very much. All the activities which were conducted offline were very good and the way kids were involved from all age groups whether it was sports or annual day or a outgoing trip, those were awesome. Online teaching at this age is very much encouraging and approaching to kids. They put all the skillful activities in online teaching and it is  successful and so interesting. We believe that not only our son but all the kids would have been benefitted by the hard work, dedication and love of the teachers.

Finally we would like to rate alpha academy teaching & learning 5/5 including the infrastructure facility. Hats off to all administration and all the loving teachers who have made our child's learning very good and made him feel at home. We are really grateful to God for giving such opportunity to our son's life to study in this school.

Thankyou to all teachers , so experienced, knowledgeable. I wish i could continue here for higher classes.
Wishing alpha academy all best wishes. Special thankyou to aunty(who help kids) there, all teachers, principal thankyou so much.

featured_reviews.name: Avyaansh Rai
featured_reviews.review_text:
It has been a wonderful experience to be associated with Alpha Academy School. My child was part of the school for 2 years and school has made sure that they take out best in the child. I had such a beautiful experience for the academic year 20-21. School has shifted to home and online classes were in place. Teachers were teaching in such a way that it actually didn't feel like they are teaching..rather the classes were full of fun and joy.
Teachers are extremely knowledgeable and experienced and have an amazing command over the concepts. Throughout the year every week school had come up with fresh and life relatable themes which itself is commendable. Keep shining the way you are...Best wishes

featured_reviews.name: Gordon Dcosta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amara’s first school/ play group.

We are absolutely delighted with our experience at The Kids Company Colaba. From the moment we walked through the doors, we knew this was the perfect environment for our child (Amara) to grow, learn, and thrive. The warm and welcoming atmosphere created by the dedicated staff makes every child feel at home.

The teachers & principal Ms Vibhuti /Ms Heena and Ms Kavita are not only highly skilled but also incredibly nurturing. They go above and beyond to ensure each child receives personalized attention and care. Our child has flourished under their guidance, developing both socially and academically in ways we could have only hoped for.

The curriculum is thoughtfully designed to balance play and learning, fostering creativity, curiosity, and a love for exploration. The wide range of activities, from arts and crafts to outdoor play, field trips, boat rides & Montessori learning method of education ensures that every day is filled with fun and discovery. We’ve also been impressed with the emphasis on social skills and emotional development, which are so crucial at this young age.

Moreover, the facilities are clean, safe, and equipped with age-appropriate resources that enhance the learning experience. We particularly appreciate the frequent communication from the school, keeping us informed and involved in our child’s progress.

We highly recommend “The Kids Company Colaba” to any parent seeking a nurturing, stimulating, and supportive environment for their child’s early education. This school has truly been a second home for our family, and we are grateful for the positive impact it has had on our child’s (Amara) development.

100% recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Sejal Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently attended a pasta and dessert-making workshop at APCA Mumbai, and it was one of the best learning experiences ever! 👩🏻‍🍳
The chefs were incredibly skilled yet so friendly — they made everything simple and easy to understand. We prepared a Mushroom Risotto and a gourmet dessert, and honestly, the results were just like a professional chef’s creation.
What I loved most was that APCA doesn’t just teach recipes, it focuses on real techniques, hands-on learning, and working in a professional kitchen environment.
The academy is super well-organized, uses top-quality ingredients, and the vibe is full of passion and creativity. Highly recommend APCA to anyone who wants to turn their food passion into skill! 💯

featured_reviews.name: Nirav Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at APCA was truly amazing. I got the opportunity to learn a lot of new things, improve my skills, and gain valuable hands-on experience. The environment was very professional and supportive, and the guidance from the chefs and staff helped me grow both personally and professionally. It was a great learning journey, and I’m grateful for the experience.

featured_reviews.name: Riya Amin
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an amazing experience either trove - this was my first time but definitely coming back again. Everything was perfect - right from the chef explaining the whole process in such a clear and concise manner to the whole facilitation process done by the trove team. Had such a fun time! Definitely recommend

featured_reviews.name: Valentina Quadros
featured_reviews.review_text: My three-month intensive course at Academy of Pastry & Culinary Arts was an incredibly enriching and hands-on learning experience. The program helped me strengthen my foundation in pastry and bakery while also introducing me to modern techniques and professional kitchen practices. The chefs and mentors were knowledgeable, supportive, and pushed us to constantly improve our precision, creativity, and discipline. It was a fast-paced yet rewarding journey that gave me both confidence and valuable industry exposure.

featured_reviews.name: Aashvi Sinha
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently attended a sushi and tiramisu making workshop and the experience was amazing. The chefs were very friendly and encouraging. Ended up having the best tiramisu ive ever had! Would recommend this to everyone!!

featured_reviews.name: V D
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely delightful experience! Chef Anirudh and assistant chef Shreya, and Anika were fantastic instructors who made learning to bake breads a breeze. We had a blast making baguettes and pretzels, and their guidance was top-notch. The session was beginner-friendly, informative, and super helpful. They broke down complex techniques into easy-to-follow steps, and their patience and enthusiasm were contagious. We thoroughly enjoyed the hands-on experience and can't wait to try more recipes. Kudos to the team for an amazing session! 5/5 stars

follow their instagram page and you will know next free workshop.

featured_reviews.name: Selena Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at this culinary school was incredibly rewarding. The instructors are knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in student success. The hands-on training prepared me well for a professional kitchen, and I appreciated the emphasis on technique, sanitation, and time management.
